[!exec:git] skip Git is not installed
# A linked Git worktree uses the primary worktree's board.
exec git init repository
cd repository
exec git config user.name 'Weft Acceptance'
exec git config user.email weft-acceptance@example.invalid
exec git commit --allow-empty -m initial
exec git worktree add ../linked --detach

exec weft$exe init
exec weft$exe add 'Primary worktree task'
cd ../linked
exec weft$exe add 'Linked worktree task'
exists ../repository/tasks/backlog/001-primary-worktree-task.md
exists ../repository/tasks/backlog/002-linked-worktree-task.md
! exists WEFT.md

exec weft$exe list backlog --json
json
stdout '"title": "Primary worktree task"'
stdout '"title": "Linked worktree task"'
